title: nf-nomad deployment and validation templates
description:
Reproducible infrastructure templates and a reviewer protocol for nf-nomad, the Nextflow executor plugin for HashiCorp Nomad. Includes a single-laptop Multipass deployment, a heterogeneous cloud deployment spanning OCI and GCP preemptible instances, per-mode Nextflow configurations (shared POSIX filesystem, Fusion, nf-nomad-s5cmd), and a preemption-resilience harness.

Companion artefact to the nf-nomad manuscript.
